original_goal: Provide an interactive local model lab that discovers available Ollama models, explicitly controls loading, runs cataloged benchmarks, and presents durable credible results through the Locaily frontend and backend.
completed: Created branch codex/benchmark-lab-m3-interactive-local-model-lab after M2 reached ready-for-delivery.
Added registered Ollama model inventory with separate runtime, installed, loaded, loadable, manifest, exact identity, and qualification states.
Added explicit bounded per-model load and unload controls without automatic bulk loading or downloads.
Added an allowlisted summary-safe suite catalog and exact-provenance preflight for quick and qualification modes.
Added an isolated Benchmark Lab worker with versioned summary-safe JSONL events; companion code does not import benchmark-lab/engine.
Added durable summary-safe run storage and start, list, detail, live-event, cancellation, duplicate, and server-restart recovery APIs.
Added unified shell inventory, launcher, live progress, M2 result/provenance/gate display, history, and refresh recovery.
Added diagnostic model and benchmark status to the legacy console while keeping the unified shell as the primary workflow.
Added M3 schemas and automated fixture/integration/recovery/privacy/frontend tests.
Completed a real browser benchmark with llama3.2:latest and exact digest provenance; verified durable refresh recovery.
Fixed cold-model load timeout handling and responsive desktop layout clipping found during live browser acceptance.
Hardened development lifecycle tests to snapshot and restore real control-plane state.
Hardened deterministic milestone review so untracked source files are included in secret and scope checks.
Kept raw prompts/responses and local run artifacts out of default APIs and Git; no evidence was promoted and no qualification or routing changed.
next_required_action: Follow the canonical project state. No follow-on Benchmark Lab milestone is approved.
